Brand Book · v1.0 · Nov 2026

sreenidhiholidays.com

P.06

Journeys for every kind of traveller

Four kinds of trips, one promise: fully managed, from booking to the journey home.

01

Domestic group tours

With our own kitchen. Kashi, Kashmir, Rajasthan, Andaman, North-East and more.

02

International group tours

Sri Lanka Ramayana, Dubai, Vietnam, Thailand, Bhutan, Singapore and Malaysia.

03

Custom packages

Goa, Bali, Shimla–Manali, Chardham, Nepal Muktinath, Coorg, Hampi and more.

04

Pilgrimage, weekend and bike trips

Jyotirlinga circuits, short getaways and the Leh–Ladakh bike trip.

1.4 Our promise

Brand Book · v1.0 · Nov 2026

sreenidhiholidays.com

P.07

Four things every traveller should feel

In every post, call and trip. Draft — confirm with the Sreenidhi team.

We care.

Travellers are guests, not bookings. Elders, families and first-timers get the same attention.

Home food, far away.

Our own kitchen on group tours sets us apart. Show it often.

Fully managed.

Tickets, stays, guides and food, planned end to end, so the trip is stress-free.

Trusted since 2005.

Two decades of travellers. Let their real reviews do the talking.

2.1 Primary logo

Brand Book · v1.0 · Nov 2026

sreenidhiholidays.com

P.09

Anatomy of the logo

1  Rising sun — the start of every journey

2  Flight path — travel near and far

3  City skyline — landmarks and destinations

4  Location pin — we take you there

5  SREENIDHI — bold red, the name people trust

6  Sunset “o” — the stripe that inspires our pattern

Always use the supplied file. Never redraw, recolour or rearrange it.

2.2 Logo system

Brand Book · v1.0 · Nov 2026

sreenidhiholidays.com

P.10

One logo, four versions

Versions 2–4 are proposals cut from the supplied logo, nothing redrawn. Confirm with the client before use.

1  Primary logo

The default. Website, posters, itineraries, signage.

2  Wordmark

Wide, short spaces. Website header, email signature, bus side.

3  Emblem

When the name is already nearby. Video intros, merchandise.

4  Badge

Profile pictures, favicon, WhatsApp, stickers.

SREENIDHI HOLIDAYS

2.3 Clear space and size

Brand Book · v1.0 · Nov 2026

sreenidhiholidays.com

P.11

Give it room to breathe

Clear space on every side equals x, the height of the “S” in SREENIDHI. Keep text, photo edges and other logos out of it.

Scale the logo up or down as one piece. The clear space scales with it.

SREENIDHI HOLIDAYS

2.4 Logo on colour

Brand Book · v1.0 · Nov 2026

sreenidhiholidays.com

P.12

Always on a light ground

The red name and dark skyline need white or Cream behind them. On red, orange, dark colours or photos, use the badge or a white panel.

White — best

Cream or Sand — yes

On red — badge or white panel

Directly on dark — never

SREENIDHI HOLIDAYS

2.5 Logo misuse

Brand Book · v1.0 · Nov 2026

sreenidhiholidays.com

P.13

Never do this

No. Stretch, squash or skew it.

No. Recolour it — never in blue or green.

No. Rotate or tilt it.

No. Place it on red, orange or busy photos.

No. Blur it, or add shadows and glows.

No. Fade it or lower its opacity.

No. Crop parts of it.

No. Use it below minimum size.

3.5 Colour rules

Brand Book · v1.0 · Nov 2026

sreenidhiholidays.com

P.19

The 60–30–10 rule

60% light — white or Cream, so photos and the logo breathe.

30% support — Sand panels, Warm Ink text, tints.

10% red — the one thing you want clicked or remembered.

Readable pairs (contrast checked)

Text on backgroundRatioUse
Warm Ink on Cream17:1Body text
Cream on Sreenidhi Red4.6:1Buttons, headlines
Warm Ink on Orange6.5:1Labels, tags
Warm Ink on Yellow10.9:1Price tags
Stone on Cream6.2:1Captions
White on Orange2.8:1Never
White on Yellow1.6:1Never

5.1 Sunset stripe pattern

Brand Book · v1.0 · Nov 2026

sreenidhiholidays.com

P.24

The sunset stripe

Taken from the sunset “o” in Holidays: a sun disc cut into bands, red at the top fading to yellow.

Use it for poster corners, story backgrounds, slide dividers, merchandise and tour bags.

Sunrise or sunset — a disc may sit half below a horizon line.

Keep it behind, never on top of text, prices or the logo.

Voice

6.1  Brand personality

6.2  Tone in practice

SREENIDHI HOLIDAYS

6.1 Brand personality

Brand Book · v1.0 · Nov 2026

sreenidhiholidays.com

P.27

A caring travel friend who has done it all before

Warm, reassuring and full of good ideas. Never pushy, never vague.

Caring

Reassuring

Joyful

Rooted

Do this

Speak to families and elders with respect

Say what’s included: food, stays, guides

Share the wonder of the place

Honour pilgrimage and tradition

Not this

Pushy “last seats!!!” pressure

Hidden costs or vague plans

Emoji walls and ALL CAPS

Jokes about faith or culture

SREENIDHI HOLIDAYS

6.2 Tone in practice

Brand Book · v1.0 · Nov 2026

sreenidhiholidays.com

P.28

How we write

Place and feeling first, then the plan: days, dates, what’s included.

English and Kannada both welcome. One or two emoji per caption at most.

Always Sreenidhi Holidays — never “Srinidhi” or “Sreenidhi Tours”.

WRITE THIS

Kashi with home-style food, every day of the trip.

Your parents travel. We take care of the rest.

Let’s plan your next trip.

NOT THIS

CHEAPEST TOUR IN BANGALORE!!!

Hurry, only 2 seats left, book now or miss out!

Best travels. Contact for details.

7.2 Reels and stories

Brand Book · v1.0 · Nov 2026

sreenidhiholidays.com

P.31

Reels and stories safe zone

On every 1080 × 1920 reel and story, keep text, logo, prices and CTAs inside the safe area. Instagram covers the shaded parts with its own buttons and captions.

Top band — keep clear

y 0–192 · profile name, progress bar

Right column — keep clear

x 918–1080, from y 820 down · like, comment, share

Bottom band — keep clear

y 1500–1920 · caption and audio

WEEKEND GETAWAY

Coorg

[Dates] · from ₹ __

Enquire Now

Hook in 2 seconds. Destination name and one reason to watch.

Badge, not full logo on video — small, top-left.

End card (1–2 s): full logo on white, phone number, CTA.
